Pretty simple.

Get a canister of Nitrogen (find it somewhere cheaper, just an example). You can probably get it filled at a Welding shop. Not sure what types of canisters would work, but you could just ask if you would prefer to use a cheaper type.

Get one of these: http://www.buyemp.com/product/curaplex-oxygen-mask-total-non-rebreather

Attach to canister and face. Lay down. Turn on canister (not full-on, just enough to where you are breathing nitrogen only). Experiment with it first for flow. I'd use my hands to feel how strongly the gas is coming out and just aim for "enough to feel" but not "lots of pressure".

You need the canister to last like 10 minutes. To the point where you are brain dead.

"Won't this make me feel like I'm suffocating?" No. Suffocation is a direct cause of build-up of Carbon Dioxide in the blood. The thing that makes you want to breath is that build-up when you hold your breath. Not "I want Oxygen." But "I want to get rid of Carbon Dioxide."

This is why sitting in a garage with your Car on and the door closed is another way people choose. Cars exhaust Carbon Monoxide which isn't the same thing and has a similar effect.

Whatever you do, don't use Dry Ice. Dry Ice is solid Carbon Dioxide. Breathing the fog off Dry Ice would be the worst way to die. Maximum suffocation pain.

What breathing the Nitrogen will do is simple. Replace all the Oxygen in your blood with Nitrogen. You'll pass out. Your body will die quickly due to lack of Oxygen.

Personally, if it were me, I'd grab one of these: http://www.usasafety.com/two-wheel-gas-cylinder-dolly-1-cylinder-p-73.html

I'd lug that around with me to my chosen public location. I'd lay down on a park bench and turn on the gas. Close my eyes and that'd be that.

No mess for others to worry about. I'd be found quickly enough to deal with decay, but not quickly enough to prevent death. "Oh, that young man must be sick. (the canister) I'll leave him alone so he can rest." Minimum trauma to whoever finds me is the goal in this situation.

You only need like 10 good minutes of no oxygen. Say, pick a bus station with no one around but you know a bus is scheduled in 30 minutes. That kinda thing.

I personally am too proud to commit suicide, but if I ever change my mind on that, this is how I'd do it.

Minimum possible pain but leads to death.
Minimum trauma to whoever finds you.
Minimum mess to be bothered with by whoever finds you.
Minimum effort on your part so easier to actually commit to.

Best of all possible considerations imo.
